LSE 0.5.4 prefills more than twice as fast on the R9700 and decodes faster with DFlash2 and MTP. It builds its HRX and Loom dependencies from patches it carries itself.

**Requires mac_linuxgpu v0.1.151 (build 255) or later** on macOS, as 0.5.3 did. The measurements below were taken on v0.1.156 (build 260), with 0.5.3 measured on the same driver for comparison.

## Changes

1. **Faster prefill.** 4- and 8-bit projections of 16 rows or more run as a tiled f16 matrix-core GEMM over an f16 copy of the activation. Wide passes use 64x64 wave tiles, and K is sliced when the grid would leave compute units idle. The GDN prefill scan gives each state row to a pair of threads. Flash prefill attention stages values through workgroup memory, and `l2_normalize` uses a wave per row at any row count. A prompt's remainder runs as one padded pass. On the pinned configuration, a warm 4K prompt prefills at 1,455 tok/s, up from 678 in 0.5.3.
2. **Shorter time to first token.** Fresh recurrent state and KV storage are cleared in issue order instead of after a device wait. Freed device buffers go to the next allocation of the same size. A step's kernels load together at its first cache miss. The prompt's last DFlash2 context pass runs after the first token. A warm 137-token prompt answers in 0.18 s, down from 0.68 s.
3. **Faster decode.** Short-query attention is tiled by occupancy. The lm_head and query projections load weights four chunks at a time, and the decode down projection spreads over every compute unit. Short GDN scans preload their inputs and read shared key heads in place. Speculative verify passes fuse their q/k preparation and batch their launches between two drains. Sampled verification reads a device top-k instead of whole logit rows. MTP drafts chain on the device. A 640-token decode runs at 49.9 tok/s with DFlash2 and 50.8 tok/s with MTP=3, up from 40.9 and 44.9.
4. **HRX patches carried in LSE.** The seven HRX patches that the macOS, iOS and Linux builds fetched from the archived mac-amdgpu repository now live in `patches/hrx`. They apply to hrx-system 5927b0e0 in the same order. `cooperative-matrix-operands.patch` and `loom-grow-arrays-only-when-full.patch` grow loomc's arrays only when full, so kernels with many matrix operands, such as the 64x64-tile GEMM, compile instead of failing with `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`. The iOS build now fetches hrx-system at the macOS pin and patches it itself.
5. **CPU backend fixes.** The fused GDN q/k preparation has a host reference, a vocabulary narrower than the device top-k reads whole rows, and closing an MTP session releases its proposal buffer.

## Performance

Qwen3.8-27B Q4 with the Q8 DFlash2 draft on an R9700, mac_linuxgpu v0.1.156 (build 260), `--batch-size 1024 --ubatch-size 1024 --kv-cache-dtype bf16 --kv-len 262100`, `LSE_REQUIRE_DEVICE_KERNELS=1`. Warm is the median of three requests after the first at that size.

| Prompt tokens | Warm TTFT | Warm prefill | Cold TTFT | 0.5.3 warm TTFT |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 137 | 0.183 s | 749 tok/s | 0.370 s | 0.675 s |
| 271 | 0.287 s | 944 tok/s | 0.455 s | 0.988 s |
| 532 | 0.478 s | 1,113 tok/s | 0.660 s | 1.449 s |
| 646 | 0.565 s | 1,143 tok/s | 0.812 s | 1.434 s |
| 1060 | 0.811 s | 1,307 tok/s | 1.119 s | 1.893 s |
| 2118 | 1.479 s | 1,432 tok/s | 1.611 s | 3.312 s |
| 4230 | 2.907 s | 1,455 tok/s | 2.928 s | 6.237 s |

| Mode | 640-token decode | Draft acceptance | 2K prompt (2406 tokens) | 4K prompt (4786 tokens) | 0.5.3, 640-token decode |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| DFlash2 | 49.9 tok/s | 65.5% | 48.5 tok/s, TTFT 1.57 s | 54.7 tok/s, TTFT 3.16 s | 40.9 tok/s |
| MTP=3 (`--mtp qwen38-27b-mtp-q8 --mtp-depth 3`) | 50.8 tok/s | 68.9% | 49.1 tok/s | — | 44.9 tok/s |
| Plain (`--dflash2=off`) | 28.5 tok/s | — | 28.5 tok/s, TTFT 1.55 s | — | 27.5 tok/s |

Model load, launch to ready with the checkpoint in the file cache: 3.8 s with DFlash2, 3.2 s plain, 3.4 s with MTP. The first request after start (137 tokens) answers in 0.37 s.

## Downloads

| Asset | For |
| --- | --- |
| `lse-v0.5.4-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon with an external AMD GPU and the [mac_linuxgpu](https://github.com/lemonade-sdk/mac_linuxgpu) driver |
| `lse-v0.5.4-ios-arm64.xcframework.zip` | iOS/iPadOS 26+ apps that embed the mac_linuxgpu driver; contains `LSE.xcframework` |
| `lse-v0.5.4-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux x86_64 with ROCm 7.x |

Each asset has a `.sha256` beside it. The C ABI version is unchanged (`LSE_ABI_VERSION` 1).
